visual_traits.composition: Clean centered product framing with enough negative space.
visual_traits.lighting: Soft directional light with controlled highlights.
visual_traits.material_realism: Surface texture is credible enough for reuse guidance.
visual_traits.product_fidelity: Product silhouette and defining details are stable.
visual_traits.commercial_fitness: Suitable as a reusable positive reference after human acceptance.
visual_traits.memory_suitability: Useful as a positive visual pattern once a memory gate exists.

reuse_conditions: Reuse only as a visual reference after checking the source review report.
Do not treat this schema fixture as a live accepted registry entry.
Do not reuse for production without a separate production gate.
